note: SymbolicLM configuration (DS021 "SymbolicLM"). `stanza.package` picks the English Stanza package: `default` (charlm models) or `accurate` (Stanza `default_accurate`: electra-large POS, dependency parser and NER). Environment overrides: CHATSOP_STANZA_PACKAGE, CHATSOP_STANZA_DIR (resources dir of the default package, also Romanian and the sentence splitter), CHATSOP_STANZA_ACCURATE_DIR, CHATSOP_STANZA_HF_HOME, CHATSOP_STANZA_LEMMA_MODEL (the lemmatizer file of the accurate package; it keeps the default package's combined_nocharlm lemmatizer). `~` is the home directory.

uncertainty.note: true adds the reason `parsers_disagree` (the other Stanza package parses each English sentence and its core arcs are compared); it runs a second worker and roughly doubles latency, so it is off by default.
